prompt: In a photorealistic photo, a bustling school gymnasium hosts a science fair under bright fluorescent lights. On the left, a boy in a blue hoodie leans forward with intense curiosity, his eyes fixed on a bubbling green liquid inside a clear glass beaker. Next to him stands a girl with pigtails wearing a yellow dress, who is pointing excitedly at the chemical reaction while holding a clipboard. In the center, a teacher in a gray suit sits on a folding chair, observing the students with a calm expression. Beside the teacher, a small brown hamster rests inside a transparent plastic cage placed on a white tablecloth. To the right of the cage, a volcano model made of papier-mâché erupts with fake red lava, drawing the attention of a man in a red scarf who stands nearby with his arms crossed. Behind the volcano, a robot constructed from silver cardboard boxes stands motionless, its wire antennas twitching slightly. A black cat with white paws sits on the floor near the robot, looking up at the mechanical structure. In the background, a woman in a floral blouse walks past a poster board covered in colorful charts. Another student, wearing glasses and a green shirt, stands next to the woman, carrying a stack of books. The final entity is a red balloon tied to the leg of the teacher's chair, floating gently above the floor. There is no sunlight streaming through windows, and there is no digital screen visible in the scene. The boy in the blue hoodie is handing a pen to the girl with pigtails. The man in the red scarf is looking at the volcano model. The black cat is sitting on the floor next to the robot. The teacher in the gray suit is sitting on the folding chair.
